## ✨ Highlights

Fixes for what v2026.11.20's and v2026.11.27's lab campaigns found.

- 🔗 **Clusters keep their stick tables across close reloads**: a
  member reloaded within a few seconds of its start no longer resets
  the counts on every member.
- 🖥️ **The Controller's Update page waits for the node's health
  check**, and says so when an update didn't hold and the node went
  back to its previous release.
- 🔐 **Let's Encrypt**: a certificate put back at boot no longer shows
  the failures of the stand-in it replaced.

## 🔗 Clusters

- **A reload waits until HAProxy has learnt its stick tables**
  ([#731](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/731),
  [#701](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/issues/701)). A HAProxy
  being replaced hands its stick tables to the new process only once it
  has learnt them itself, which takes up to 5 seconds after it starts.
  A member reloaded before that started with empty tables, counted
  from zero under traffic and sent those small counts to the other
  members: a key's count was reset on every member, and each reload
  less than 5 seconds after it did it again. janusd now waits, before
  a reload, until the running HAProxy has learnt the cluster's tables,
  up to 11 seconds, and logs `haproxy: reloading once the stick tables
  were learnt (…)`. A HAProxy running for more than a few seconds has
  learnt them, so the usual reload doesn't wait.
- What stays is HAProxy's own: the new process serves from the moment
  it takes the listeners, so a key it counts in the fraction of a
  second before the old one hands the tables over starts from zero
  for that moment - a few dozen increments per key and reload under
  heavy load
  ([Clusters](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/cluster.md)).

## 🖥️ Controller

- **The Update page waits for the node's health check**
  ([#730](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/730),
  [#726](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/issues/726)). With "Revert
  automatically" on, the page said "Back on <new release>" as soon as
  the node answered on its new slot, while janusd was still checking
  HAProxy there, then nothing when the node went back to its previous
  slot a minute later. It now follows the node's event log until
  janusd decides: "Updated to …, HAProxy answered healthy", or "The
  update didn't hold" with HAProxy's error once the node is back on
  its previous release. A page opened later shows a notice naming the
  release that didn't come up, when and why, until it is dismissed or
  another update moves the node
  ([Updating nodes](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/guide/updates.md)).
  It comes with the Controller's update: the page reads the event log
  the nodes already keep.
- **Restart janusd says what moves** on the node's Power page
  ([#729](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/729),
  [#702](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/issues/702)): HAProxy keeps
  running, but keepalived and BIRD restart with janusd, so a VRRP
  master's virtual IPs move to the backup and back, and a BGP node's
  routes are withdrawn and announced again.

## 🔐 Let's Encrypt

- **A certificate put back at boot drops its stand-in's failures**
  ([#727](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/727),
  [#703](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/issues/703)). A node that
  hung while removing a certificate (fixed in v2026.11.20) puts the
  real certificate back at its next boot, but `janusctl haproxy acme
  status` and the Controller kept showing it "failed (3 in a row)"
  with a next attempt that never came. The failures are now cleared
  once the real certificate is back in place.

## ⌨️ janusctl

- `janusctl system restart`, its help and the TUI's Restart action say
  the same as the node page: HAProxy keeps running, the virtual IPs
  and BGP routes move away and back
  ([#729](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/729)).

## 📚 Docs

- The architecture page says what the kernels build: no lockdown LSM,
  and no loadable kernel modules at all - every kernel is built
  without module support
  ([#728](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/728),
  [#722](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/issues/722)).

## 🧪 Tests and tooling

- `qemu-cluster-test` no longer sleeps before its reload: the reload
  waits for the tables and the test checks the console says so
  ([#731](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/731)).
- v2026.11.27's lab campaign
  ([#725](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/725)).
